title: Periodical Repair and Maintenance of Chowra Lighthouse Tower under Port Blair Directorate.
summary: Periodical repair and maintenance of the 24 m trestle tower at Chowra Lighthouse, Chowra Island, Nicobar: synthetic enamel repainting plus dinghy trips for site inspection.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair

sites.name: Chowra Lighthouse, Chowra Island, Nicobar
sites.work: Repainting of trestle tower (24 m), cleaning of premises, replacing trestle tower angles where required

scope.item: Synthetic enamel painting to the previously painted surface of Trestle power (24m high) with approved first quality brand (Asian/Berger/Dulux/Nerolac high glossy) in two or more coats at all heights, including removing worn out paint, primer on worn places, bosun chair/jhulla/scaffolding
Engaging mechanised dinghy along with safety boat with one operator and one helper for the inspection of site by officials, including fuel, water, labour, tools & plants

money.performance_security: Performance Bank Guarantee 10% of contract value, valid sixty days beyond completion; refunded 3 months after completion subject to no defects
money.notes: Bid Security Declaration in prescribed format instead of EMD (bidder suspended 3 years if withdrawing or failing to sign/submit performance security). Rates inclusive of all taxes including GST. First & final bill on actual measurement after TDS.

period.completion: 03 months from the date of issue of Work Order

eligibility: Proof of satisfactory completion of similar works during last 7 years in Central/State Government; similar work means civil works including painting
Bid acceptance letter, undertaking and bid securing declaration
Site-in-charge: graduate engineer with 2 years or diploma engineer with 5 years professional service
specs: Synthetic enamel paint conforming to IS 2933; approved makes Asian/Berger/Dulux/Nerolac or equivalent approved by DLL
Waterproofing compound: Pidilite/Dr. Fixit/Fosroc; metal surface putty: Iroseal or equivalent
Shades: trestle tower Snow white/Brilliant White and Signal Red; automation box & handrail Bus green; gate, pedestal Black
Scope: painting of trestle tower, cleaning of lighthouse premises, replacing angles of trestle tower wherever required
